title: STLTH Nexa Device
description:
Discover the STLTH NEXA Device! Specifically designed for STLTH 2ML Pods, including STLTH Original Pods, STLTH X Pods, STLTH MONSTER Pods, and STLTH SNAP Pods, the STLTH NEXA packs innovation into a sleek, palm-sized form factor that fits effortlessly into your hand or pocket.

The STLTH NEXA Device boasts an upgraded 650 mAh battery, ensuring extended vaping sessions without the constant need for recharging. When it’s time to recharge, the USB-Type-C port gets you back in action quickly.

The LED screen on top provides clear digital battery indication, so you’re always aware of your device’s power levels. For a personalized experience, the airflow adjustment control located on the underside allows you to fine-tune your draw.

Features:

- 650 mAh Battery Capacity

- Precise Airflow Adjustment

- LED Screen with Battery Indicator

- Compatible with STLTH Original Pods, STLTH X Pods, STLTH MONSTER Pods, and STLTH SNAP Pods

- Rechargeable Via USB Type-C

Includes:
1 x STLTH NEXA Device
1 x USB Type-C Charging Cable
1 x Instruction Manual
